note: Defaults checked 8 Oct 2026 against the latest listed patch (6 Oct). All presets are enabled and editable. Conditional timers track one location. Rift alerts indicate a variable window; the Urn reminder covers its first descent.

rules.name: Small jungle camp
rules.note: Mark cleared when the last haunt in your tracked camp dies. Add separate rules for other locations.

rules.name: Medium jungle camp
rules.note: Fully clear your tracked camp, including any Sinner’s Sacrifice machines, before marking cleared.

rules.name: Large jungle camp
rules.note: Mark cleared when your tracked camp is fully cleared.

rules.name: Boxes & golden statues
rules.note: One reminder for surface boxes and golden statues. First 3:00; earliest respawn 3:00 after clearing. Edit for tunnels or other locations.

rules.name: Bridge buffs
rules.note: Fixed match schedule: 5:00, 10:00, 15:00 and every 5 minutes thereafter.

rules.name: Soul Urn
rules.note: First descent at 10:00; lands 12.5 seconds later. Later spawns nominally every 5 minutes, but carrying delays them. This preset alerts only the first descent.

rules.name: Unstable Rift
rules.note: Visual effect can appear at 10:00–12:00. Mark appeared when you see it; the next window is 6–8 minutes later. Capture opens 80 seconds after that effect.
